::: {#def-graph-generator .theorem}
# Graph generator

A graph generator gives the entries of an random graph with $n$ nodes. It is an $n \times n$ function $[f_{\psi_{ij}}]_{i,j \in \mathcal N}$ whose entries $\psi(i,j)$ are each a deterministic, symmetric function of other variables in the model along with an error term.   

$$
\psi(i,j) = f_{\psi_{ij}}(\mathbf{Pa}(\psi(i,j)), U_{\psi_{ij}})
$$

such that 

$$
U_{\psi_{ij}} = U_{\psi_{ji}} \text{ and } f_{\psi_{ij}} = f_{\psi_{ji}}
$$


:::
